v2-26.candidate: The king said to Abiathar the priest, “Go quickly to Anathoth, to your field. For you are a man deserving death this day, but I will not put you to death, because you did carry the ark of the Lord’s covenant before my father and did suffer all the hardships my father suffered.”

v2-29.candidate: Solomon was told, “Joab has fled to the Lord’s tent, and behold, he is holding fast to the altar’s horns.” Solomon sent to Joab, asking, “What has happened to you, that you have fled to the altar?” Joab said, “I was afraid of you, and I fled to the Lord.” King Solomon sent Benaiah son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, kill him and bury him.”
